name: @liminal/design-system-solid
description: Solid Storybook gallery that VIEWS liminal-desktop's src/components/ui from a sibling checkout. Desktop stays the source of truth; this package owns stories, provenance, and its own Panda codegen.

scripts.panda: npm run -s link && panda codegen && panda cssgen --outfile styled-system/styles.css && npm run -s provenance
scripts.build: npm run -s panda && storybook build -o storybook-static
